models.name: Baby Metroid Lamp
models.description: The larval Metroid in real LEGO, about 18 cm across, as a tap lamp: press it down and its four fangs bite and its three red nuclei light up; press again and they go dark.
models.notice: Metroid is © Nintendo. This fan model is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo.

models.name: The Caldwell County Courthouse
models.description: The 1894 Second Empire courthouse in Lockhart, Texas, as a 46 cm LEGO display model on a 30 cm lawn: buff stone walls with red trim, four corner pavilions under slate mansards with iron cresting, a columned portico and a central clock tower whose four clocks really keep time (quartz clock inserts behind the red dials). The dome lifts off to set them.

models.name: Chainsaw Face
models.description: Chainsaw Face, a masked slasher in a butcher's apron, as a 31 cm (12 in) brick-built figure on a display stand: neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, waist, hips, knees and ankles all pose, and he swings his chainsaw from high overhead down across his hips.

models.name: Ferret
models.description: A curious, life-size ferret mid-bounce in real LEGO: arched back, bandit mask, tongue out, and a head that turns on a turntable. Three coats: sable, albino and cinnamon.

models.name: VHS Cassette
models.description: A 1:1 VHS video cassette in real LEGO, 184 x 102 x 26 mm: an inner chassis with the tape run, lamp tube and reel spindles inside a shell with two big clear windows; the full-length dust flap swings up and both reels turn.
